subject: general
question: The Talcher Thermal Power Station is located in which state?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Talcher Thermal Power Station** is located in the state of **Odisha**, India.
 
• It is situated in the **Angul district**, which is known for its significant industrial and mining activities.
 
• The power station is operated by the **National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC)**, which is one of India’s largest energy conglomerates.
 
• Talcher is a prominent hub for **coal mining**, and the coal extracted from this region is used as a primary fuel source for the power station.
 
• The Talcher Thermal Power Station plays a crucial role in meeting the **energy demands** of Odisha and neighboring states.
 
• It is part of the larger **Talcher coalfield**, which is one of the largest coal reserves in India.
 
• This power station contributes significantly to the **national grid**, ensuring a steady supply of electricity for industrial and domestic purposes.
 
• Talcher is also known for other **thermal power plants**, such as the NTPC Talcher Super Thermal Power Plant, which further enhances the region's energy production capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Andhra Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is a state in southern India known for its **Krishnapatnam Thermal Power Plant** and other energy projects.
 
• The state has abundant **coal reserves** and is a major contributor to India’s energy sector.
 
• It is also known for its **renewable energy initiatives**, especially in solar and wind energy production.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 __
 
• **Rajasthan** is known for its **solar power plants**, such as the Bhadla Solar Park, which is one of the world’s largest.
 
• It also has thermal power plants like the **Suratgarh Super Thermal Power Station**.
 
• Rajasthan has limited coal reserves but compensates with its focus on **renewable energy**.
 
 
 
• **Bihar**__
 
 
• **Bihar** has thermal power stations like the **Barauni Thermal Power Plant**.
 
• The state faces challenges in energy production due to limited natural resources but relies heavily on power imported from other states.
 
• **Hydroelectric projects** on rivers like the Kosi also support Bihar’s energy needs.
